# Load data

esviritu_human = human viruses detected from 2020-2021 & 2024-2025 samples with EsViritu

*_ANI90 = same df but with only detections with >= 90% average nucleotide identity

```{r}
#esviritu_res <- fread(here("data", "Esviritu_HostDiseaseClassification.tsv"))
esviritu_human <- fread(here("data", "Human_data.tsv"))
sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("data", "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")
```

```{r}
sample_metadata$Year_cat <- ifelse(sample_metadata$Year == "2020" | 
                                     sample_metadata$Year == "2021", 
                                   "2020-2021", "2024-2025")
```


```{r}
esviritu_human_ANI90 <- esviritu_human %>%
  filter(avg_read_identity >=0.90)
```

## Hierarchical tax table for each detected species

```{r}
hierarchical_dt <- esviritu_human %>%
  distinct(species, genus, family,
           order, tclass, phylum) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(species = gsub("\\W+", "", species)) %>%
  mutate(genus = gsub("\\W+", "", genus)) %>%
  mutate(family = gsub("\\W+", "", family)) %>%
  mutate(order = gsub("\\W+", "", order)) %>%
  mutate(tclass = gsub("\\W+", "", tclass)) %>%
  mutate(phylum = gsub("\\W+", "", phylum))
``` 

```{r}
hierarchical_df <- as.data.frame(hierarchical_dt)


hierarchical_df <- as.data.frame(unclass(hierarchical_df),
                                 stringsAsFactors=TRUE,
                                 row.names = "species")

cols <- colnames(hierarchical_df)

tax.phy <- taxo2phylog(as.taxo(hierarchical_df))
```

Group RPKMF by sample_ID/species
```{r}
species_meta_dt <- merge(esviritu_human, sample_metadata,
                         by = "sample_ID") %>%
  #group by year category (2020-2021 and 2024-2025)
  group_by(Year_cat) %>%
  #count total_samples as the number of unique sample names in year category
  mutate(total_samples = n_distinct(sample_ID)) %>%
  # ungroup by year category
  ungroup() %>%
  #count how many distinct samples contained each species (n)
  group_by(species, Year_cat, total_samples) %>%
  summarize(n = n_distinct(sample_ID)) %>%
  #freq= proportion of samples (60) that contained each species
  mutate(freq = n / total_samples) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #fill the possible missing combinations with 0
  complete(nesting(Year_cat, total_samples), species,
           fill=list(n=0, freq=0))

freq_info_dt <- species_meta_dt %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  #total_number = total number of samples where the species was found
  #h_freq= relative frequency per year (frequencies add up to 1)
  mutate(total_number = sum(n),
         h_freq = freq/ sum(freq)) %>%
  #get the relative requency of a species wrt 2024-2025
  #1 if was detected onöy in 24/25, 0 if only in 20/21
  filter(Year_cat=="2024-2025") %>%
  select(species, total_number, h_freq) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(species = gsub("\\W+", "", species))
```

```{r}
t1 <- ggtree::ggtree(tax.phy, layout = "daylight",branch.length = "scaled",
             color="grey40", size=0.2)

```

```{r}
freq_info_dt$total_number <- as.numeric(freq_info_dt$total_number)
```

Family level annotations based on these:
geom_text(aes(label=node))
View(t1@data)

```{r}
fonts <- theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "bold", hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5))
```


```{r detection-freq-annotation}
pal <- park_palette("DeathValley")

tax_tree <- t1 %<+% freq_info_dt + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=total_number, size = total_number), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c(pal[6], pal[2], pal[1]),
                        breaks = c(1,30,60,90,119),
                        labels = c("1", "30", "60", "90", "120") ) +
  
  scale_size_continuous(breaks = c(1,30,60,90,119),
                        labels = c("1", "30", "60", "90", "120") ) +

  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Total Detections (1-120)"),
         size = guide_legend("Total Detections (1-120)"), nrow=1) +

  xlim(-8,12) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 317, label = "Anelloviridae", fontsize = 8, hjust=0.4) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 312, label = "Adenoviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=-0.2) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 306, label = "Astroviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=-0.2) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 296, label = "Picornaviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=-0.1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 293, label = "Caliciviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=-0.1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 289, label = "Coronaviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=-0.1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 285, label = "Picobirnaviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=-0.1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 275, label = "Orthoherpesviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=-0.1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 270, label = "Poxviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=-0.1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 264, label = "Pneumoviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=0, vjust=1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 260, label = "Paramyxoviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=-0.1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 254, label = "Orthomyxoviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=0, vjust=1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 249, label = "Flaviviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=0.5, vjust=2.5) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 244, label = "Hepeviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=1, vjust=1.5) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 239, label = "Sedoreoviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=1.1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 233, label = "Genomoviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=1.1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 227, label = "Circoviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=1.1) +
  geom_cladelab(node = 216, label = "Parvoviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=4.1, barsize=0) +
  geom_taxalink(taxa2="s__Bufavirus3",taxa1="s__Bocaparvovirusprimate1",
                color="black", curvature=0.4, offset=-0.02, ncp=3) +
  
  geom_cladelab(node = 207, label = "Papillomaviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=3.3, 
                vjust=-2, barsize=0) +
  geom_taxalink(taxa2="s__Papillomavirushomo8923",taxa1="s__Humanpolyomavirus16",
                color="black", curvature=0.6, offset=-0.02, ncp=5) +
  
  geom_cladelab(node = 201, label = "Polyomaviridae", fontsize =  8, hjust=1.2, vjust=-0.2) +
  
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        #legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 25),
        legend.text = element_text(size=25),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)) +
  fonts
tax_tree

```


```{r detection-freq-year-annotation}

  geom_tippoint(aes(color=h_freq, size = total_number), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low=pal[6], high=pal[1], mid=pal[2], midpoint=0.5,
                        breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
```
